description: BeschleunigerBallett's Renovate config. Everything shared lives in the preset at ContainerHub's repository root (default.json); the `extends` line below is the whole adoption, exactly as in OmniAccelerANT and jotrockenmitlocken.

The part this repo cannot get any other way is the git-submodules manager, which Renovate DISABLES by default. This repo carries fifteen gitlinks - two owned (third_party/ContainerHub at `main`, third_party/OxidANT at `develop`) and thirteen vendored - and not one of them has ever had a bump proposed by anything. The hub gitlink is the expensive one: the Linux and Windows lanes run the gates that live behind that pin, so a stale gitlink means CI grades this tree with whatever the hub looked like the last time someone moved it by hand.

The manager bumps a gitlink to the tip of the branch named in .gitmodules, falling back to the remote's DEFAULT branch when none is named. Every submodule here now names its branch explicitly except third_party/FUZZTEST, which is the one case where no value is correct - see the comment above that section in .gitmodules, and the packageRule below that stops the fallback from acting on it unattended.

Actions: the preset's helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests will propose digest pins for the third-party actions this repo references by tag (actions/checkout@v7.0.1, actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.1, codecov/codecov-action@v7.0.0, SamKirkland/FTP-Deploy-Action@v4.4.0), while a preset rule explicitly leaves the five Kataglyphis/ContainerHub composite actions at @main for the upstream-first change flow.

Unlike the three sibling consumers, this repo has never carried a .github/dependabot.yml, so adopting the preset is a pure addition here - there is no hand-over to sequence and nothing to delete afterwards.

Renovate resolves `github>Kataglyphis/ContainerHub` from ContainerHub's DEFAULT BRANCH, not from the pin in third_party/ContainerHub, so a preset change reaches this repo only after it is merged there. And this file stays completely inert until the Renovate GitHub App is installed on this repository: no bot has ever authored a commit here.

third_party/FUZZTEST is notification-only, because the git-submodules manager cannot track it correctly on its own. The pin 704efb34 is the tip of google/fuzztest's dated release branch release_2026-06-29; it is not on main (compare main...704efb34: ahead 1, behind 81). With no `branch =` in .gitmodules the manager falls back to the remote default, main, so an unattended PR here would silently move this repo off the release line and onto trunk.

Naming release_2026-06-29 in .gitmodules would not fix it either - that branch is frozen at exactly this commit, so the entry would look watched while never producing an update. Upstream cuts a new release_<date> branch per release, which is a human decision.

dependencyDashboardApproval keeps the available update VISIBLE on the dependency dashboard and only refuses to open the PR unattended; it is not a suppression. Moving this pin means picking the next release_<date> branch by hand.
The depName for the git-submodules manager is the submodule PATH, which is why the match is on `third_party/FUZZTEST` rather than a package name.
